subject: Cloud Computing
title: The Certificate Expiry Disaster
description: A quick win: understand The Certificate Expiry Disaster.

hook.text: In 2020, Microsoft Teams went down because a TLS certificate expired. Nobody renewed it. A calendar reminder failed too.

buildup.text: TLS certificates have expiration dates. When they expire, browsers and services refuse to connect — by design.

discovery.text: Expired certificates have taken down Spotify, LinkedIn, and even government services. It's embarrassingly common.

twist.text: Certificate expiry is 100% preventable. Automated renewal tools exist. Yet major companies still let certificates lapse.

climax.text: Let's Encrypt and automated managers have reduced the problem. But manual certificates still catch people off guard.

punchline.text: A preventable expiry took down Teams. Automate renewals.

quiz.question: Why do certificate expiry outages still happen at major companies?
options: Manual certificate management is error-prone and automated renewal isn't always configured
Certificates can only be renewed during business hours
Cloud providers intentionally let certificates expire to sell new ones

details.summary: Expired TLS certificates have caused major outages at Microsoft, Spotify, and LinkedIn. When a certificate expires, all encrypted connections fail instantly. Despite being entirely preventable, teams forget to renew certificates because manual tracking processes break down.
details.whyItMatters: Certificate expiry is one of the most entirely preventable causes of outages. Automated certificate management eliminates a failure mode that has taken down some of the world's largest services.
takeaways: Expired certificates cause instant total service failure
Major companies including Microsoft have been affected
Automated renewal with services like Let's Encrypt prevents this

faq.question: Why do certificate expirations still cause outages?
faq.answer: Large organizations manage thousands of certificates across many teams. Manual tracking in spreadsheets breaks down. Certificates embedded in load balancers, APIs, and internal services are easily forgotten. Without automated monitoring and renewal, expiry is inevitable.

faq.question: How can certificate expiry outages be prevented?
faq.answer: Automate certificate renewal using ACME protocol with services like Let's Encrypt. Implement certificate monitoring that alerts weeks before expiry. Maintain a comprehensive certificate inventory. Use short-lived certificates that force automated rotation.
